Optional delivery setup

Reminders while the laptop is off.

Weekwise can use a small Cloudflare service to run a daily reminder schedule independently of your laptop. The website and all case records remain separate from that service.

You can try the tracker first.

Cases, weekly activities, notes, evidence, and backups work without cloud setup. Reminders stay off until you connect a service and enable a delivery channel.

What your developer sets up

  1. Deploy the included cloud-reminders Worker and its D1 database using the repository’s cloud reminder guide.
  2. Set the allowed website origin to the address hosting Weekwise, and create a private connection token.
  3. Add email or SMS provider credentials to Cloudflare secrets. Email uses Resend; SMS uses Twilio. Provider account setup and charges are separate.
  4. Give you the HTTPS service URL and connection token. Provider credentials never belong in this website or its public source.

Connect from Weekwise

  1. Open Reminders & settings → Connect cloud reminders.
  2. Paste the service URL and connection token, then choose Connect service.
  3. Choose email or SMS, enter your recipient, and set the daily time and deadline window. The screen shows the time zone used when saving.
  4. Enable daily reminders and save. A test reminder is available after saving a delivery channel.

Connecting cloud reminders pauses any active local reminder schedule. The cloud uses the latest dates synced from this browser. Open Weekwise and wait for synchronization after changing a case or restoring a backup.

What leaves this browser

The service receives active-case counts, unfinished deadline dates, and your delivery preferences, including the recipient. Patient names, activity titles, notes, and evidence are excluded. Messages contain counts and date windows.

The connection token stays in this browser’s local storage, separately from case backups. Keep your original token somewhere secure. Connecting reminders does not synchronize cases between devices.

Pause or disconnect

Turn off daily reminders and save to pause delivery. Disconnect cloud reminders first disables the cloud schedule, then removes the saved connection token. If the service cannot be reached, Weekwise keeps the connection so you can retry. Clearing browser data alone does not stop a cloud schedule.

Local reminders remain available through Start Weekwise.cmd; those require the laptop awake, online, and the local service running.
